pieces.text: Floating exchange-rate regime weights: 30% short-term external debt, 10% other portfolio liabilities, 5% broad money, 5% exports.

pieces.accept: 100-150 percent; verdict by the 100 percent threshold.

pieces.text: The output gap (actual vs potential output) comes from a statistical trend of GDP such as a Hodrick-Prescott filter (or a WEO / production-function estimate); the budget is then adjusted for that gap.
pieces.accept: HP filter or other statistical-trend or production-function potential output; HP smoothing parameter not fixed.
